A01.standing_orders: The Halo run comes first: 1.17e11 brains, live migration only, and the count never drops below 1.17e11. Domains within 70 ly beam at least 50% of their power to the Halo, reroute around failures, and keep a 10% repair reserve. If unknown craft or 0.2c objects come within 100 ly, alarm, harden, sweep the incoming bearing, and spread spares and checkpoints. Stay more than 10 pc from supernova risks. Outbound seeds settle quietly, stay small, and hold peaceful beacons.
